skill.summary: Swiss Public Transport real-time information. Use when querying train, bus, tram, or boat schedules in Switzerland. Supports station search, departure boards, journey planning from A to B, and connection details. Use for queries like "When does the next train leave from Zürich?" or "How do I get from Bern to Geneva?" or "Show departures at Basel SBB".

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Swiss Public Transport skill
- Real-time departure boards for all Swiss stations
- Journey planning with detailed connections
- Station search with autocomplete
- Includes helper script for formatted output
- No API key required - uses transport.opendata.ch
